answer: Put TPM endorsement key certificate binding at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. Cloning 729 keys multiplies the price 729-fold: 86751 POA locked, or 10206 minutes burned, against a single honest agent's one-time cost. Hold the forge up to the light, weigh the hollow of the attack, and keep the ember of the verdict where everyone can audit it. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
